Bill.BriefDescription: Regarding the extension of sewer services in aquatic rehabilitation zone one.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the effect of extension of sewer services inaquatic rehabilitation zone one; and adding a new section to chapter36.70A RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 36.70A RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) In aquatic rehabilitation zone one established in RCW90.88.010, the development of one or more systems of sewerage asdefined in RCW 35.67.010 and 36.94.010 or the extension of an existingsystem of sewerage to serve areas outside a designated urban growtharea is permitted when such a development or extension serves: (a) A marine recovery area created in accordance with chapter70.118A RCW; (b) A shellfish protection district created in accordance withchapter 90.72 RCW; or (c) A defined geographic area determined by the secretary of healthunder RCW 43.70.170 to be a threat to the public health. (2) When a system of sewerage is developed or expanded undersubsection (1) of this section, it must comply with the intent of RCW p. 1 HB 160536.70A.110(4) by limiting its service capacity to that which willaccommodate only parcels of record on the date the pertinent marinerecovery area, shellfish protection district, or public health threatarea was created. (3) For purposes of this chapter, the development or extension ofa system of sewerage outside an existing urban growth area does notprovide a basis for designation of that area as urban, nor does itprovide a basis for rezoning of the served area to allow development ata greater density than that which existed before the system of seweragewas created.
